bullets.text: 50 Masts Activated in Wales - **Shared Rural Network** reaches a significant milestone, enhancing mobile coverage in rural areas.
AI Drives Test Demand - The surge in **AI** infrastructure is creating unprecedented needs for test and measurement solutions.
Turkcell's AI Strategy - **Turkcell** partners with **Huawei** to advance AI capabilities and 5G evolution.
VMO2 Flags Scam Calls - **Virgin Media O2** uses AI to label over 1 billion suspected scam calls, enhancing customer safety.
Military 5G as Blueprint - Military deployments provide a model for resilient private networks in commercial sectors.
AI Era Reshapes Telecom - **Jio** CEO predicts the AI transition will redefine telecom economics and create new opportunities.
AI in RAN Testing - **Keysight** launches unified AI-RAN testing workflows to streamline validation processes.
AI and Digital Divide - Industry leaders stress the importance of digital skills and infrastructure for AI inclusion.
AT&T's $250bn Investment - **AT&T** commits over $250 billion to enhance U.S. connectivity and infrastructure.
AI Infrastructure Shaping Telecom - **Turkcell** emphasizes the role of AI and data sovereignty in telecom's future.
